_doc: Endpoint-clean strand for canonical 3-point MACE. The primary PCSK9 page remains STALE for search_not_executed and its main pool intentionally includes broader published MACE definitions; this strand decomposes the canonical three-component evidence only.
why_topic_is_suppressed: Not suppressed. The strand is supplemental because the registered page already has a broader primary composite pool, and the search remains stale.

members.selection_note: Key secondary endpoint; same canonical 3-point component set.
Selected prespecified co-primary by the 2026-09-16 component-set rule.

pooled_ci_refused.detail: Registered PM/HKSJ uses t(1)=12.71 at k=2; the interval is not served as a pooled confidence interval because a single degree of freedom is not reliable here.

ci_hksj_unserved.note: computed for auditability only; not served as the registered interval at k=2

pool.fixed_note: common-effect sensitivity (z-based; not the registered interval): this uses inverse-variance common-effect weights and a normal quantile, not the registered PM/HKSJ interval.

declared_absent.reason: Cached abstract reports a four-component composite including unstable-angina hospitalization; matching 3-point ODYSSEY OUTCOMES is not in the committed abstract.
